description.en: Frees a camera previously created with CMND_CREATE_CAMERA or CMND_LOAD_CAMERA.
Handle of the camera to free.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Free a loaded camera once the shot is done
CMND_DELETE_CAMERA(hCamera);
